name: Splunk Real User Monitoring
description: Add the Splunk RUM (Real User Monitoring) script to pages.
project_description:
Splunk Real User Monitoring (RUM) pinpoints issues that impact customers with end-to-end visibility from browser or mobile app to backend services. This is a part of the Splunk Observability Cloud solution.

 Features 
 The module provides a configuration interface to add an accesstoken, application name and environment to add properties to the SignalFX javascript.

 Post-Installation 
 Install the module like always. Go to /admin/config/splunk-rum and add the required parameters. Save, and the script is added. 

 Additional Requirements 
 This only works if you have an up and running Splunk Observability environment.

 Recommended modules/libraries 
 - OpenTelemetry 

 Please note that if you get "Unhandled export error" in OpenTelemetry, you should try the following solution:

 https://www.drupal.org/project/opentelemetry/issues/3416011#comment-154…
